title: Overridable settings envelope — an e-heading title wrapped in the universal overridable union (component definition tree shape)
_comment: SPEC 2.0 (components controller WP) — the COMPONENT DEFINITION tree shape (the elements array POSTed to the components create/update routes): the prop the component exposes is wrapped in the {"$$type":"overridable"} envelope carrying override_key + origin_value (modules/components/overridable-schema-extender.php: overridability is universal-by-union on every atomic settings prop EXCEPT classes). The dry-run validates it as a page tree because the schema extender unions the whole props schema site-wide once e_components is on — the same validation path Document::save runs for a component document.
